note: Rewritten from Light 1930 (a monograph of the California Amitermes), pp. 187—190; original in English; in the four-column soldier table one "minimum head length" cell is blank, so the head length is given only as maximum 1.18 and mean 1.12; the worker "thorax width" mean of 0.64 is inconsistent with its minimum and maximum, and is transcribed as printed.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Alates not described. Soldier small, head capsule about 1.12—1.18 mm long and about 0.95—1.03 mm wide, head index about 0.88, head constriction index about 0.77; mandibles slender, pale, not strongly curved, basal projection not large, mandible curvature index I about 0.25 and index II about 0.08, head-mandible index about 0.72; mandibular tooth at the outer third of the mandible, sharp, directed basally. Postmentum wide, widest near the posterior end, broadly and shallowly constricted at the middle, postmentum constriction index about 0.95. Antennae slightly longer than the head, pale yellowish brown. Worker mean head width 0.95 mm and length 1.12 mm; mandibular teeth blunt; basal projection of the right mandible longer than the distance between it and the base of the second tooth; basal projection of the left mandible pointed, not convex on its proximal side.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head and antennae yellow, mandibles pale yellow at the base, becoming pale yellowish brown towards the apex; legs, thorax and ventral surface of the abdomen white, the dorsum of thorax and abdomen tinged pale yellow; abdomen dark owing to the dark contents. Abdomen not very swollen, slightly cylindrical, posterior end blunt. Head (dorsal view) broad, widest near the posterior margin, sides slightly convex, posterior margin nearly straight, posterior corners broadly rounded, narrowing forwards from the posterior end, head index about 0.88, head constriction index about 0.77; head rather high, posterior and lateral surfaces steep and curved, frons steep and truncate; fontanelle projection small, bearing a dense tuft of pale red hairs of unequal size. Mandibles narrow, about half as thick in dorsal view as wide, slightly upturned from the base, weakly curved inward from the middle; basal projection small and low; mandible curvature index I 0.25, II 0.09; mandibles shorter than the head; head-mandible index about 0.76; tooth at the outer third, sharp, shelf-like, directed basally, projecting inward very little. Antennae longer than the head, 14-segmented, segment IV shortest, segments III—V together about twice as long as segment II. Labrum in dorsal view as in the original figure B. Postmentum wide, constricted behind the middle, postmentum constriction index about 0.95. Pronotum as in the original figure S. Measurements (mm): head length 1.12—1.18 (mean 1.12, n = 4 heads); maximum head width 0.95—1.03 (mean 0.99); head width between the anterior lateral corners 0.65—0.75 (mean 0.69); minimum head width 0.71—0.82 (mean 0.77); mandible length 0.81—0.83 (mean 0.82, n = 5); postmentum length 0.56—0.60 (mean 0.58); maximum postmentum width 0.31—0.34 (mean 0.33); minimum postmentum width 0.30—0.33 (mean 0.31); pronotum width 0.47—0.64 (mean 0.50, n = 2); labrum length 0.25 (n = 1); labrum width 0.20 (n = 1); head index 0.84—0.93 (mean 0.88); head constriction index 0.73—0.80 (mean 0.77); postmentum constriction index 0.91—0.97 (mean 0.95); gula length 0.67—0.68; mandible curvature 0.17; minimum mandible curvature 0.07.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Body small, head width not exceeding 1 mm; abdomen not very swollen, cylindrical, dark owing to the contents; head shape close to that of the worker of A. wheeleri. Measurements (mm): true head length 0.79—0.84 (mean 0.82, n = 4); head length to the clypeus 0.56—0.65 (mean 0.61); head width 0.91—0.98 (mean 0.94); distance between the mandibular articulations 0.43—0.47 (mean 0.44); clypeus length 0.28—0.33 (mean 0.30); antennal length 1.00—1.12 (mean 1.06); mandible length 0.47—0.48 (mean 0.47); pronotum length 0.25—0.29 (mean 0.26); pronotum width 0.47—0.54 (mean 0.51); thorax length 0.43—0.53 (mean 0.48); thorax width 0.69—0.70 (mean 0.64); abdomen length 0.96—1.43 (mean 1.19); abdomen width 0.78—1.00 (mean 0.89).
